_comment: Research presets for the Project Agent. Edit freely: every field is data, no code. Queries use {topic}. source_domains only re-orders sources (matching pages are inspected first), it never hides anything. collect describes what the report keeps for that preset.

presets.label: GitHub research
presets.description: Find repositories and libraries for the subject; read README, licence, releases and API surface.

presets.label: Docs / API
presets.description: Read the official documentation and API reference for the library or service in question.

presets.label: UI / design references
presets.description: Collect design-system, component and template references as screenshots, palettes and layout notes. References only — the UI we build is generated in that style, no template code is copied in.

presets.label: National search
presets.description: Nationwide web and records search: candidate businesses, listings and public records, deduplicated by name with the region and source kept for each.
